text:
anika: Proposal: a short-run triage mode for new trials to reduce noisy claims and lower renewal risk false positives. Working label: trial-triage. Plan to pilot next week.
ravi-cs: Sounds useful. Which accounts qualify?
anika: Narrow cohort: trial_age <= 10 days, health_score between 0.4 and 0.65, product_events_last7 < 2, and no owner-claimed tag.
lee-ops: Also add "recent_plan_change == false" to avoid churny upgrades.
anika: Good call. Actions: single short email nudge + in-app tooltip; no owner SMS, no auto-escalation. Optional micro-survey at +72h if email delivered.
sam-prod: Copy note: survey must be one optional checkbox: "Was setup clear?" Keep legal in the loop.
jordan-analytics: I'll add observability: metrics `triage_rate`, `triage_fp_pct`, `trial_retention_30d_by_mode`. Can we export a 40-account QA sample?
anika: yes please. Draft config (ops-friendly):
```
mode: trial-triage
criteria:
  - trial_age <= 10
  - 0.4 <= health_score <= 0.65
  - product_events_last7 < 2
  - owner_claim == false
  - recent_plan_change == false
actions:
  - email: brief nudge (template id: cs-triage-v1)
  - in_app: setup-tip
  - survey: opt-in at +72h
  - sms: disabled
rollout: canary 0.05 -> 0.3 -> full
monitoring_thresholds:
  - triage_fp_pct > 0.03 -> alert #customer-success
  - retention_delta < -2% -> halt rollout
qa_sample_size: 40
```
survey-bot: Scheduled: survey window T+3d for mode=trial-triage (job id: sv-3344).
lee-ops: I'll add the feature flag and small infra guard to prevent duplicate nudges.
jordan-analytics: Once dashboards wired Ill run a backfill comparison vs baseline for the last quarter.
anika: Rollout plan: canary 5% Mon 09:00 PT -> 30% Wed -> evaluate through Friday. If triage_fp_pct spikes or retention drops we rollback.
ravi-cs: cc @legal @enablement for survey language.
anika: Thanks everyone. If no blockers Ill open the FF and flip the canary Monday morning. :white_check_mark:
